caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular composition featuring a stylized, symmetrical floral motif in red on a cream or light beige background. The floral elements include large leaves, rounded flower petals, and curling stems, filling the majority of the central space. The floral design is bordered on the left and top sides with a vertical strip containing repeated, organic shapes that mimic the central floral pattern, also in red. On the right side, there is a distinct vertical border composed of two narrow parallel lines filled with small hash marks, immediately adjacent to the floral area, followed by a wider band featuring a geometric pattern of alternating red and white triangles forming a zigzag or chevron effect. The design is contained within a thin double-line frame, and the entire drawing is set against a plain background with no additional elements or colors outside of red and cream or light beige.
title: Homespun Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
